entities.summary: Jean-Marie Loret was a French railway worker who claimed to be Nazi dictator Adolf Hitler's illegitimate son. According to Loret, his mother revealed to him in 1948 that Hitler was the "unknown German soldier" with whom she conceived a child during World War I. Hitler's valet Heinz Linge claimed in his memoirs that he witnessed Heinrich Himmler speak over the phone with Hitler, implying he wanted to find a woman and her son in their French village.
